findings.issue: Squared Euclidean norms can overflow or underflow despite finite components. For risk [1e200,0], sqrt(dot(row,row)) becomes infinite and division makes the normalized constraint zero; tiny nonzero risk rows can be skipped. Related dose and NaN-slope paths also lacked finite checks.
findings.minimal_fix: Stable hypot norms for risk/own/projected vectors, finite checks of dot/solve/projection/dose/native displacement intermediates, and a finite strictly negative descent slope before copying a nonzero trial.
findings.title: Finite nonzero risk gradients must not disappear during cone normalization
findings.verification: Source review plus source-bound author fixture for the same analytical cone at over/underflow scales; no auditor floating sweep.

findings.issue: The initial prior document could read as subtracting an already-negative probe responsibility.
findings.minimal_fix: State nonnegative factual responsibility-weighted CE/BCE gradient minus nonnegative probe responsibility-weighted CE/BCE gradient.
findings.title: Avoid double-negative wording for the probe gradient

focused_checks.Bernoulli_marginal_pooling: Hard observed binary entry matrix is required. Entrywise negative BCEWithLogits is mixed only over members, then averaged across queries/labels. Positive rho=p/(M*q), negative rho=(1-p)/(M*(1-q)); no across-label normalization or joint-label product.
focused_checks.categorical_pooling: Observed categorical log probabilities are pooled over members by logsumexp; logits use native log-softmax and log-probability mode preserves the native Jacobian. Exact dJ = rho_f dCE_f - rho_a dCE_a.
focused_checks.finite_safeguards: Stable norm/intermediate/slope checks repair the identified cone issue. Reference/score/derivative/guard validity and finite rejection with private rollback are explicit; native callback exceptions invalidate the plan.
focused_checks.honest_guarantees: Zero-budget J and absent nonincrease imply aggregate supplied risk nonincrease for the frozen-peer surrogate. Nonzero guard tolerances weaken exact inequalities. No heldout, per-query, all-updated-absent, complementary-prediction, causal-source, novelty or utility guarantee.
focused_checks.private_shared_ownership: Complete named-parameter/object/storage coverage; actual shared identity; private/nonsteered separation. Source replay requests autograd.grad only for declared private parameters and checks .grad/version stamps. Private copy trials do not receive or update optimizer moments.
focused_checks.same_recipient_removal: For recipient m assigned a, all frozen peers are selected by OutputKey(train_probe,k,a), not each peer assignment. Native removal correctness remains caller-owned.

required_unqualified_integration_conditi: Torch autograd/output-cotangent replay, exact native Jacobians and atomic private update/rollback must be qualified in a real integration.

Shared AND member-owned prediction-relevant buffers, including SeHGNN BatchNorm running states, must be frozen or exactly snapshotted/restored before and after every reference/replay/trial/eval guard; additional source calls must not become hidden normalization training.

Native graph caches, support/path rebuilds and normalization state must correctly reflect removal of exactly the recipient family and required reverse/derived paths, while retaining other families and query-own features.
Exact per-view dropout/RNG replay and mode restoration must be qualified; the helper parameter/.grad stamps do not certify these states.
Actual TRAIN-role/query/output ordering, complete hard binary label semantics and native own-loss reductions require provenance bindings and qualification.

Eligible factor sites require actual factual/probe Jacobian evidence. A factor acting only on a zeroed removed channel can have zero probe Jacobian and reduce to positive weighted factual CE/BCE. Two forward calls do not establish two nonzero private gradient terms.
